isolation_deviation: After pin verification, one wc -l glob counted lines in unlisted C4 proposal files. No content was displayed and no unlisted substantive premise was used; the report discloses this metadata-only deviation.

dispositions.result: Conditionally sufficient at every eligible rank. Three crossing-rank mixed minors plus three auxiliary LC tails suffice; all-rank mixed minors are stronger quantifier ranges. No universal property is proved.

R-I is absent in the new route; deletion minors coincide in orientation but differ in range and LC debt; R/P is shifted relative to r19 K/P. The two sufficient packages are not logical aliases. R19 deletion-ratio tests were independently checked only through m=16; its fresh m=513..2048 tests omitted them.

Exact reformulation, not a bound. A new local matching-slack decomposition is proved in REPORT.md; it does not settle the selected weighted inequality. The T22 selected arm tag has e_T(B)=34>k=33, L_B=nu_B=0.
The H_v-neighborhood version has coefficient n-2p; the equivalent T-neighborhood version has n-2p+1, since N_T(A union {v}) equals N_H(A) disjoint union {s_v}.
A coefficientwise binomial comparison gives an explicit O(m^-2) bound for the z(1+z)^(3m+1) perturbation relative to B^m on m<=r<=2m+1, m>=5. This is not a curvature or aggregate proof.
